intro.fr: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel a des mods de randomisation et se joue en multiworld Archipelago depuis 2026, grâce à un fork de Bouncy Loot God.
intro.en: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel has randomization mods and has been playable in an Archipelago multiworld since 2026, through a fork of Bouncy Loot God.

text.fr: 2K Australia et Gearbox Software sortent Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel en 2014.
text.en: 2K Australia and Gearbox Software release Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel in 2014.

text.fr: Le dépôt communautaire BLCMods, créé en mars 2017, rassemble des mods pour la série, dont des randomizers. La liste rando-list recense aussi un randomizer d'armes de Turk pour Cheat Engine.
text.en: The BLCMods community repository, created in March 2017, gathers mods for the series, including randomizers. The rando-list catalog also lists a gun randomizer by Turk for Cheat Engine.

title.fr: Bouncy Loot God pour The Pre-Sequel
title.en: Bouncy Loot God for The Pre-Sequel

text.fr: Adaptor-Face crée le 9 mai 2026 un fork de Bouncy Loot God, l'intégration Archipelago de Borderlands 2 d'EdricY, et y ajoute un APWorld pour The Pre-Sequel ; la version 0.2.0 sort le 19 mai.
text.en: Adaptor-Face creates a fork of Bouncy Loot God, EdricY's Archipelago integration of Borderlands 2, on May 9, 2026, adding an APWorld for The Pre-Sequel; version 0.2.0 comes out on May 19.
